What changed and why.

## Checks

The commands from CONTRIBUTING.md (Checks) that ran, and their results.

## Measurements

For a change to rendering, the runtime or the request path: the tool, the build, the runs, and
the numbers before and after. Otherwise, none.

## Review

Who reviewed it against the values (README.md, Values), and each finding with what was done
about it. A review that found nothing says so, and what it could not check.
